protocol.description:
The kv_store protocol is implemented for a key-value store for applications.
It can be expected that the kv store implements proper security measures to protect the values inside. This store is suitable to hold secrets.
kv_store is an exclusive protocol. It must be exposed with the exclusivity flag.

object.name: hp_hyprtavern_kv_store_manager_v1
object.description: This object is a core manager object bound upon creation.

c2s.name: set_value
c2s.description:
Set a value in the kv store.
An app value is a value restricted to the calling process' app. "app" refers to the binary path. This does work with sandboxed apps.
An unbounded value is a value in a global value pool. It is highly recommended to use unique prefixes e.g. myapp:value to avoid trampling other values.
It is recommended to prefer app values unless an unbounded one is necessary.
The key has to contain only letters, numbers, or any of the characters: `:/.,-+=?`, otherwise an invalid_key_name error is raised. Value can contain any characters.

c2s.name: get_value
c2s.description: Get a value from the kv store.

s2c.name: store_available
s2c.description:
The Kv store is by default locked. Sending any request before receiving a store_available event will result in a store_unavailable protocol error.
The user will be prompted to unlock the Kv store as soon as it's possible.
If the store is already unlocked, this event is sent immediately upon binding the protocol.
It is safe to assume that if the protocol is bound, and after a roundtrip this event is not emitted, the store is closed.

s2c.name: value_obtained
s2c.description: Response from the kv_store with the value.

s2c.name: value_failed
s2c.description: Response from the kv_store with an error in obtaining the value.
